entry.title: Oregon Adds 5,800 Jobs in September as Unemployment Rate Edges to 5.0%
entry.summary: Oregon added 5,800 jobs in September as its unemployment rate edged down to 5.0%. Construction and health care led hiring, but statewide employment grew just 0.1% over the past year.

entry.title: After Years Away, Everything Pumpkin Festival Returns to Canyonville October 24
entry.summary: After years away, the Everything Pumpkin Festival returns to Canyonville’s Pioneer Park on Oct. 24. The free event runs from noon to 7 p.m. with live music, pumpkin contests, children’s games, a costume parade, and a giveaway of 200 pumpkins.

entry.title: Roseburg Temperatures to Reach Mid-80s Before Weekend Cooldown
entry.summary: Roseburg will reach the mid-80s Thursday and Friday before cooling to around 68 Saturday. Morning fog returns this weekend, while rain chances remain low heading into early next week.

entry.title: Fire Season Ends in Northwest Oregon; Douglas District Remains in Fire Season
entry.summary: Fire season ended Oct. 15 across five ODF districts in northwest Oregon, but remains active in the Douglas District. Debris burning is still prohibited on DFPA-protected lands. The Umpqua National Forest continues to list moderate fire danger.

entry.title: RUSA Completes $1 Million Solar and Battery Project at Roseburg Office
entry.summary: RUSA has completed a $1 million solar and battery project at its Roseburg office, designed to offset the building’s annual electricity use and provide backup power. Two larger solar installations are planned next.
